+title: '[MultiTool] Sandbox globals: status, wait, cancel, elicit, notify, progress'
+---
+Repo: this repo. Basis: eventplan.md §"The sandbox globals" and the capability-contract table.
+
+## What
+Add six top-level globals to the snippet sandbox (installed the way `help`/`docs` are, in `MultiTool.makeHelpDocsHostFunctions`-style factories in `MultiTool.swift`):
+- `status(completionToken?)` — promise; with a token, that run's lifecycle; with no argument, lists each pending run from the session mailbox: token, op, latest progress. Run plane only — never bulk output.
+- `wait(completionToken, seconds)` — promise; awaits settlement via the mailbox with a deadline.
+- `cancel(completionToken)` — promise; invokes the honest canceler, returns the honest outcome.
+- `elicit(request)` — promise; parks through `ToolContext.elicit` on the ambient context (same elevation path as every other call; the model itself can stop mid-snippet for a user answer). String shorthand `elicit("question")` maps to a form-mode message-only request.
+- `notify(detail)` / `progress(detail)` — synchronous, void: enqueue through `ToolContext.post`/`progress` and continue; the bridge flushes them. The outbox coalesces snippet `progress()` like any tool's progress event.
+- The one-rule contract holds: calls that do Swift effects return promises (`tools.*`, `elicit`, `wait`, `status`, `cancel`); `help()`/`docs()` stay sync reads; `notify()`/`progress()` are sync void.
+
+Surface text and pins:
+- `MultiTool.description` gains one sentence naming the ambient globals (`elicit()`, `notify()`, `progress()`, and the `status()`/`wait()`/`cancel()` run verbs). No `findAPIs` entries for globals — they are always present, not discoverable/absent.
+- Update the three globals pins: `HardeningTests` lines 187 and 193 (exact-set and README set-equality via `rawJSContextGlobals()`), `HelpDocsTests` line 114; prose lists at `README.md:124-135` and `docs/SECURITY.md:16-26`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] All six globals reachable in a fresh run; `findAPIs`/`help()` do NOT list them
+- [ ] `status()` with no argument lists a parked run's token, op, and latest progress; `wait` returns the settled result; `cancel` returns the honest outcome
+- [ ] `elicit` parks the snippet and resumes with the response when the session's `respond(elicitationId:response:)` fires; decline and cancel actions surface distinctly to the snippet
+- [ ] `notify`/`progress` return undefined synchronously and their events reach the sink with the run's correlation
+- [ ] HardeningTests/HelpDocsTests/README/SECURITY pins all updated and green
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] New `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/SandboxGlobalsTests.swift`: per-global behavior incl. promise-vs-sync contract; `status()` no-arg listing; elicit accept/decline/cancel round trips against a scripted mailbox
+- [ ] Updated `HardeningTests` + `HelpDocsTests` + description pins
+- [ ] `swift test` green
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #phase-1
\ No newline at end of file

+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01kzbj1apfzxqnnt977apfzew0
+  text: |-
+    Picked up. Research done — key findings before implementing:
+
+    **Router surface confirmed present** in `.build/checkouts/FoundationModelsRouter` (b5bf2ba): `SessionMailbox.respond(elicitationId:_:) -> ElicitationAnswerDelivery`, `.complete(elicitationId:) -> ElicitationCompletionDelivery`, `ToolContext.elicit(_:) async throws -> ElicitationResponse`, plus `status() -> [RunStatus]`, `wait(completionToken:seconds:) -> WaitResult`, `cancel(completionToken:) -> CancelResult`, `park(tool:op:kind:completionToken:settling:canceler:)`, `terminalDetailTailLimit = 4_096`.
+
+    **Seam facts that shape the design:**
+    - `RunBinding.ambient` is read once at the top of `MultiTool.call(arguments:)`; the six new globals close over that same captured binding — no second capture path, no task-local inheritance across the JS seam.
+    - `JSCInterpreter` prefixes every async-host-function rejection with the global's own name (`"<name>: <error>"`, JSCInterpreter `rejectWithMessage`), so the named error's `description` carries only the message half.
+    - `OperationEventKind` has exactly three cases (`progress`, `completed`, `elicitation`) — there is no notification kind. `notify()` therefore posts a `.progress`-kind event through `ToolContext.post(_:)` and `progress()` posts through `ToolContext.progress(_:)`, exactly as the card and eventplan §"The capability contract" state. Router's `OperationEventKind` is the seam where a distinct notice kind would land.
+    - `notify`/`progress` are synchronous void `HostFunction`s, so they cannot await. They enqueue onto a per-invocation FIFO delivery chain (the same `latestDelivery` shape `ElevatingTool`'s funnel uses) that delivers live and is awaited once after the run — "the bridge flushes them".
+    - `ResultRenderer`'s default `returnValueCharacterLimit` is 4_000, *below* `terminalDetailTailLimit` (4_096), so the bounded-`wait()` test asserts on `.detail.length`, not the detail text.
+    - Elicitation round trips are made deterministic (not timing-dependent) by `SessionMailbox.awaitAnswer`'s documented registration-happens-before-post ordering: a scripted sink answers from inside its own `post(_:)`.
+  timestamp: 2026-08-06T12:51:10.159506+00:00

+    `globalThis.notify = (function (send) { return function (detail) { send(detail); }; })(globalThis.notify);`
